new_cases.new_decision: Multiple simultaneous canvases and per-output responsive layout, rather than a single vertical or square deliverable.
Fractional frame rate plus overlap accounting; prior fixed25fps case had no overlaps.
Alpha-channel handoff and two transparent formats, absent from all52.
GIF, palette/loop constraints and strict byte cap; not a teaser MP4.
Real UI capture followed by a second renderer effect, not the earlier voice/music finish.
Specific documented effect-path collision, not generic unsupported physics.
Source-driven numerical motion and nonmonotonic data semantics, not an abstract diagram.
Seamless looping and existing watercolor art, not a sequential book montage.
Internal company use and entitlement uncertainty, not renderer price or music licence.
Account-plan chronology and saved audiovisual asset provenance, not an unentitled free user.
Stem extraction/reassembly and sum/alignment QA, absent from previous music plans.
Speaker identity, voice cloning and delivery across languages, not narration language availability.
Contradictory beat-grid versus complete-audio duration, not a consistent locked frame schedule.
Output-format interactivity contradiction, not input compatibility or ordinary UI filming.
Immersive projection and spatial audio, absent from all ordinary film examples.
Two explicit renderer ownership roles and a native still from the assembly stage, not three separate content blocks.
Mandatory visible attribution versus art direction, not generic copyright unknowns.
Cross-codec heterogeneous clip concat with forbidden normalization, not muxing one locked video.

policy: new decision dimensions and constraints, not renamed old prompts; first complete answers retained, no tuning or favourable retries
